intro.h2: Design first, then build, all under one Scottsdale roof
paragraphs: Premier Design-Build-Remodel has handled kitchen remodeling in Scottsdale, AZ and across the Valley since Greg Heden founded the company in 1994. It started as a kitchen and bath specialist. Today in-house designers also plan whole-home remodels, room additions and casitas, and the same team builds what they draw.

Your project starts at the showroom on North 80th Street, where you can touch cabinet doors, countertop slabs, tile and fixtures before you choose. You see 3D renderings and get a fixed-price proposal before construction starts. Google reviewers point to the designers by name and to steady communication on permits, updates and quality.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Scottsdale, AZ, and beyond the kitchen

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Layout comes first: traffic flow, appliance placement, island seating, storage and lighting. Then come custom cabinetry, pull-out pantries, stone counters and, when you want an open plan, wall removal with structural beams. Premier handles the permits and engineering inside the same process.

image.alt: Paradise Valley, AZ kitchen remodel from mid-century to modern, with marble-look quartz island, gray lacquer cabinets and double wall ovens

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Spa-style primary suites, walk-in showers with frameless glass, freestanding tubs, steam showers, heated floors and custom vanities. For smaller baths the team uses floating vanities, tub-to-shower conversions and vertical storage. Designers, project managers and installers work as one team from day one.

image.alt: Central Scottsdale transitional bathroom with a freestanding tub under an arched wood-slat niche and glass block window

items.name: Whole Home Remodeling
items.blurb: Connected rooms planned together, with matching flooring, lighting and finishes. Whole-home work can include moving a kitchen or bath, opening a dated floor plan and upgrading electrical or plumbing, all engineered, permitted and phased by one accountable team.

image.alt: Downtown Tempe whole-home remodel with a herringbone wood floor, black built-in cabinetry, round dining table and starburst chandelier

items.name: Casitas and Home Additions
items.blurb: Detached guest casitas, primary suite expansions and new living space. Planning covers utility connections, zoning, structural needs and permits, so the new space fits the property and the existing house. Premier's Terravita casita shows the desert-contemporary style in practice.

image.alt: Terravita desert-contemporary guest casita with stucco walls, French doors, paver walkway and saguaro landscaping

items.title: Three trade licences
items.text: Premier lists General B-135167, Electrical R-11-301243 and Plumbing R37R-318793 on every page of its site, so the work behind your walls is covered by its own licences.

items.title: A price before you commit
items.text: After design reviews and 3D renderings, you receive a fixed-price proposal. You know what the remodel costs before you sign the construction agreement.

items.title: Ten years of labor coverage
items.text: Construction workmanship is warranted for 10 years or until the home is sold, whichever comes first. Products keep their own manufacturer warranties.

items.title: Seasoned people you can name
items.text: Production VP Kent Redmond has 33 years in residential project management. Interior designer Stephanie Olesen-Bute is NCIDQ certified with more than 25 years of experience.

about.h2: Led by founder Greg Heden since 1994
about.text: Greg Heden founded Premier in 1994 and still leads it as president. The company began as a kitchen and bath specialist and grew into a full design-build firm with showrooms in Scottsdale and Mesa. Greg built the team around design, craftsmanship and project management under one roof. He is joined by Kent Redmond, VP of Production and Operations, Kym Davis, VP of Sales and Design with 45 years in remodeling, and designers such as Rachel Herrera, who came up through the tile trade, and Chris Ebert, who began his career in Chicago.

image.alt: Greg Heden, president of Premier Design-Build-Remodel in Scottsdale

steps.title: Complimentary consultation
steps.text: A one-hour meeting with a designer, usually in the showroom, about your goals, style and budget window. Call, Zoom or in person.

steps.title: Discovery and measurement
steps.text: The team photographs and measures your home, sketches simple floor plan options and narrows the investment range.

steps.title: Design and renderings
steps.text: Guided selection meetings, full 3D renderings and several revision sessions lead to a fixed-price proposal you can review.

steps.title: Contract and production
steps.text: You sign the construction agreement, meet your project manager at an in-home review, and the build begins with regular site visits.

steps.title: Completion
steps.text: A final walkthrough, punch-list work, professional photos of your new space and follow-up support from the Premier team.

testimonials.h2: Reviews from Premier clients on Google

items.name: Catie B.
items.text: They captured "us" perfectly! From the moment we stepped into their showroom, we felt that we chose the perfect place to bring our white kitchen dream to a reality. Being a stickler about quality, I did my research.

items.name: Sharon O.
items.text: We have used Premier for a total master bath remodel and just last summer, a remodel of our kitchen. Their work is top notch. Working with their designer (Rachel) was a lot of fun, and her excitement for the job was wonderful.

items.name: Debbie K.
items.text: We wanted to remodel & update our Master Bath, Guest Bath & Powder Room.Talked to several Design & Remodeling companies. After meeting with Chris Ebert, we knew Premier Design-Build- Remodel would be our overwhelming choice.

service_area.h2: Where Premier works in the Valley
service_area.text: The Scottsdale showroom sits at 16035 N 80th St, Suite D, and a second showroom is on Baseline Road in Mesa, giving East Valley homeowners two places to see materials in person. From those two bases the team remodels homes in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert and Ahwatukee. Recent portfolio projects include Troon, McCormick Ranch, Greyhawk, Terravita, Arcadia and Downtown Tempe.

items.a: Yes. Premier offers a complimentary one-hour design consultation, usually in the showroom. You can also book it as a phone call or a Zoom meeting. You see materials and the portfolio, talk about investment ranges, and leave with clear next steps for the discovery phase.

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Scottsdale?
items.a: It depends mostly on cabinetry level, structural changes, appliances and finishes, not square footage alone. Rather than quote a rough number up front, Premier narrows the range after measuring your home and then gives you a fixed-price proposal once the design and selections are done.

items.q: Do I need permits to remodel?
items.a: Often, yes. Premier notes that in Mesa, structural, electrical and plumbing changes require permits, and its Scottsdale page lists experience with city permitting requirements. Permits and engineering are managed inside the design-build process, so you do not have to file them yourself.

Premier's construction workmanship warranty lasts 10 years or until the home is sold, whichever comes first. The products installed in your home, such as appliances and fixtures, carry their manufacturers' own warranties with separate terms. Follow-up support continues after the final walkthrough.

items.q: Can I visit the showroom before I decide?
items.a: Yes. The Scottsdale showroom displays custom cabinetry, countertop materials, designer tile, lighting, plumbing fixtures and hardware. Meeting a designer there lets you compare finishes side by side. You can schedule a visit online or call (480) 573-7182 to set a time.

final_cta.text: Book a complimentary one-hour consultation at the Scottsdale showroom.
